Compare 0.538 with 0.543; experimental values can differ in a finite sample.

reassessment.prompt: A bag contains 2 red and 8 blue counters. A counter is drawn, replaced and the bag mixed 40 times; red occurs 9 times. Give theoretical P(red) and compare it with relative frequency.
actions: The bag has 2 + 8 = 10 equally likely counters.
There are 2 favourable red counters, so theoretical P(red) = 2/10.
Simplify the theoretical fraction to 1/5.
Experimental relative frequency is 9/40 = 0.225; replacement keeps the theoretical ratio fixed.
Answer: Theoretical P(red) = 1/5. Compare 0.200 with 0.225; experimental values can differ in a finite sample.
